snippet.title: An Update... | Cryorbis Studio
snippet.description:
This is a development update on our upcoming game. The message is in the video. 


[Video spoiler]
We have completed Chapter 1 and now working on Chapter 2. This game will have 3 chapters in total. Hopefully, we won't limit the game to 3 chapters only in the future.


Want to support us?
- You are always welcome to support us with anything. We have very few resources, developers, artists and budgets to keep the development alive. Your support will always help us.
- Click this link to support us!
https://www.paypal.com/donate?campaig...


FAQ:
1. How do I contact you?
- You can send us an email at cryorbisstudio@gmail.com or you can send us a message on our Facebook page.
 
2. What if it's a scam?
- This donation is optional. We understand without a proper campaign like Kickstarter or Patreon it is more likely to lean towards the 'scam'. But, our titles and published work should answer the question. You can see our work on YouTube or our Facebook page. 

3. How long has this game been developed?
- This game was first developed in mid-year 2020 and we released our first prototype gameplay in 2021 (You can watch the prototype on our YouTube channel). In October 2022 we released our very first gameplay mechanics with environments and proper models. More updates on the development will be coming soon!

4. Why not use Kickstarter or Patreon?
- These platforms require weekly/daily updates of rewards to the supporter. We are currently in need to focus on the development. We understand that we can do both at the same time, but we are a very small team working on the game. These platforms (Patreon and Kickstarter) require time, effort and budgets to provide the rewards which we can't really promise it yet. The good news is, we will launch it in a few months when the development stage is stable. If not, you can click here to support us!
https://www.paypal.com/donate?campaig...
